notes: Alternative to bdhi_c5. Places the core adjacent to the reactive carbon, which may hinder Cys approach — exactly what the 5b gate and docking will show.

structure_source: juglone and KPT-6566 verified in anchors_2; KPT-6566 carries a thioether at this ring position
notes: Leaves C3 as the Michael acceptor. Substitution on the quinone ring modulates acceptor electronics, so LUMO must be recomputed for the attached form, not inherited from juglone.

structure_source: juglone is 5-hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone — substitution on the benzo ring is precedented
notes: Leaves BOTH quinone positions free and perturbs acceptor electronics least, at the cost of a longer core-to-warhead distance.

structure_source: T_3 expert-chosen warhead (PI, 2026-07-27); acrylamide is a standard covalent Michael acceptor but has NO validated covalent-Cys113 Pin1 precedent
notes: EXPLORATORY for this target, not anchored. Chosen up front for T_3, which is why T_3 needs no warhead-reactivity triage. NOT admissible as a reactivity-window anchor: the project earlier had its own acrylamide lead, and control B5 excludes the project's own leads as anchors.

structure_source: Tian 2025 — 2-chloro-5-nitropyrimidine with an X-ray-confirmed Cys113 adduct; class recorded from the anchor in pin1_reference_binders_2.csv
notes: 2-chloro-5-nitropyrimidin-4-yl: attachment at C4, chlorine retained at C2 (the SNAr leaving group), nitro at C5 activating the ring. An earlier version of this row omitted the chlorine entirely and the warhead-validity gate correctly killed all 198 products. Aryl chloride displaced by SNAr, NOT a CH2-Cl. Mechanistically distinct from chloroacetamide and was initially misassigned to it, which produced a dock with no matching reactive atom. The SMARTS requires a ring nitrogen adjacent to the C-Cl so plain chlorobenzenes do not match.
